source_title_original: PPBUS: SPECIAL U BEAM (dimension and section-property sheet)
units: mm, mm2, mm3; self weight kN/m
reviewed: Rendered at 300 dpi and scaled from line centres on 2026-09-23 (extraction-civilcon-tum).

fitted_parameters.floor_splay: 45 degrees to the inner web face
fitted_parameters.method: Scaled from the drawing (floor line centre 199.7 mm; splay points on x = y + 499.5) and confirmed against both property rows. Round values were retained because they reproduce A within 0.010%.

geometry_notes: The catalogue index says US1/US2; the sheet and table say SU1/SU2. The sheet names are used.

SU2 is drawn solid. SU1 is modelled as the same section with the top lobe moved 300 mm down the 1:7.2 webs. This puts the SU1 lobe inner edge at 808.3 mm, against the printed 810. The 1.7 mm discrepancy is recorded and not forced.
Published areas differ by exactly 120000 mm2 = 2 x 200 x 300, which confirms the 200 mm horizontal web width.
The soffit has no chamfer drawn. None is modelled.
The self-weight column header reads kN/m3; values equal area x 25.5 kN/m3 in kN/m.
Diaphragms (400 wide at L/3 or L/4) are not part of the section.
